caption: A bucket with a tennis ball inside is tipped over, and the ball rolls out onto the floor.

sa.check: A bucket stands upright with a tennis ball inside.
The ball rolls out onto the floor.
The tip comes first and the roll out follows.

pc.expect: It is the same ball, hidden while the bucket is upright, and it comes out only through the opening.
pc.fail: A different ball comes out; or two balls; or the ball passes through the bucket's side.

pc.expect: The ball comes out only when the rim tilts low enough and rolls down and away from the opening.
pc.fail: It comes out while the bucket is upright; or rolls uphill back in; or floats.

pc.expect: The ball is not visible through the bucket.
pc.fail: It shows through; or the bucket passes through the ball; or the ball passes through the floor.
It curves; or speeds up; or stops and restarts.

pc.expect: One bucket and one ball keep their shape.
pc.fail: The bucket changes shape; or the ball turns into another object; or the ball merges with the bucket.

pc.expect: The bucket's colour and the floor stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the ball changes; or the floor rearranges.
